name: Underwriting model
what: The spreadsheet or model that projects income, expenses, debt and sale to test a price and the returns.

fields.label: Version and date
fields.definition: The model's version label and the date it was last changed, so later steps can name the version they used.

fields.label: Closing and acquisition costs
fields.definition: Title, legal, reports, loan fees and other costs to buy, entered as a total with its build-up shown in the model.

fields.label: Year-one underwritten NOI
fields.definition: Net operating income for the first year of ownership as the sponsor underwrites it, after the normalizing adjustments.

fields.label: Bridge from the seller's NOI
fields.definition: Each adjustment from the seller's stated or trailing net operating income to the underwritten figure, such as the tax reset, insurance quote, management fee and removed one-time items, with the amount and source of each.

fields.label: Assumptions at each expiration
fields.definition: For each lease at expiration or earliest exit: renewal probability, months of downtime, market rent and its expense basis, free rent, improvements and commissions, and the source of each figure.

fields.label: General vacancy and credit loss
fields.definition: The allowance applied on top of known vacancy, as a percent of potential income, and the months or years it applies to.

fields.label: Capital plan
fields.definition: Each planned capital item with its cost, year and source (bid, seller history or condition report), and whether it is funded at closing or from cash flow.

fields.label: Replacement reserve
fields.definition: The annual reserve the model deducts, and whether it comes from a lender requirement, the condition report or an assumption.

fields.label: Debt terms
fields.definition: Loan amount, rate and index, amortization, term, interest-only period, fees and reserves, with the limit that set the amount and the quote or term sheet it came from.

fields.label: Hold period
fields.definition: The number of years from purchase to the modeled sale.

fields.label: Exit assumptions
fields.definition: The exit cap rate, the year of income it is applied to and the sale costs, with the basis for the cap rate.

fields.label: Unlevered IRR
fields.definition: The property-level internal rate of return before debt, as a percent.

fields.label: Levered IRR
fields.definition: The internal rate of return on equity after debt, as a percent, and at the investor level after the promote if the model runs a waterfall.

fields.label: Equity multiple
fields.definition: Total cash returned to equity divided by equity invested, levered.

fields.label: Sensitivity results
fields.definition: The returns at the tested ranges of exit cap rate, rent growth, interest rate and downtime, and the input that moves the result most.
